headline: Take-Two Interactive Shares Decline Despite Strong GTA VI Reception
summary: Take-Two Interactive shares traded lower on the release day of Grand Theft Auto VI, even as critical reviews for the video game remained positive.
why: Take-Two Interactive is a major American video game publisher known for high-budget franchises including GTA.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive
impacts.why: Stock fell on the official release day of GTA VI despite favorable initial reviews.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Take-Two stock experienced a sell-off on the market release day of its flagship video game title.
